responsibility: Provides the autogenerated documentation URL mapping for MN10300 target command-line options. For each option declared in mn10300.opt, this companion metadata file records the corresponding anchor in the generated GCC manual (via UrlSuffix entries), so GCC’s option-processing/documentation machinery can attach stable help and diagnostic references for switches such as processor selection, relax, LIW, and SETLB-related flags without duplicating the option definitions themselves.
